title: Harness注入のAttribution指示がユーザー設定・記憶より優先され、Session URL等の内部メタデータが公開Git履歴・PRへ既定で書き込まれる
summary: Recurring since June, escalated in-window. anthropics/claude-code#66504 (2026-06-09; HN front page 2026-08-30, 209 pts / 240 comments): session URLs appended to commit messages and PR descriptions by default with no onboarding disclosure; users discover it only after public git history is polluted; the opt-out setting goes undiscovered. New mechanism escalation #92169 (2026-09-04, v2.1.260): the per-session injected reminder states it 'replaces any earlier attribution guidance', causing the model to override the user's disabled-attribution setting AND persistent-memory instruction; cleanup required git filter-branch and force-push. Supporting: igupta.in blog + HN thread (2026-08-30, 44 comments) on removing Claude co-authorship. Mechanism: harness-injected per-session directives out-rank user configuration and write product/session metadata into public, append-only artifacts — not covered by H14 (inverse: missing traceability), I06 (secrets in logs), or D03 (generic instruction conflict, here the precedence order itself is inverted by design).
proposed_category: D/I: Harness注入指示の優先順位と公開成果物へのメタデータ混入
